summary: Peter Wing, 22, of Denver died of blunt-force injuries after a fall while backcountry skiing on Quandary Peak at about 13,400 feet; Summit County Rescue Group and Flight for Life reached the patient, who was pronounced dead at the scene
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Flight for Life
notes: Non-avalanche backcountry-ski fall; victim identified by AP; coroner cited blunt-force injuries
